outgoing.name: Aberystwyth
outgoing.excerpt: Llywelyn took the opportunity to annex southern Powys and northern Ceredigion and rebuild Aberystwyth castle.

outgoing.name: Archbishop of Canterbury
outgoing.excerpt: A year later Hubert Walter, Archbishop of Canterbury, persuaded Llywelyn to release him, and Dafydd retired to England where he died in May 1203.

outgoing.name: Tower of London
outgoing.section: Death and the transfer of power
outgoing.excerpt: Gruffydd was killed attempting to escape from the Tower of London in 1244.

outgoing.name: Ireland
outgoing.excerpt: …a campaign against de Braose and his allies in Ireland, an army led by Earl Ranulph of Chester…

outgoing.name: Isle of Man
outgoing.excerpt: …uncle Rhodri's widow, daughter of Ragnald, king of the Isle of Man.
